title: Funbarus Posture Support Plush Toys Get Short TV Anime
content: Manufacturing company Dreams announced on Tuesday that its Funbarus posture support plush toy series is inspiring a short anime that will premiere on October 3 on the BS Yoshimoto channel at 11:25 p.m. JST (10:25 a.m. EDT), and on Tokyo MX on October 5 at 9:54 p.m.
author: ANN

title: Nintendo Hosts Switch Event in India
content: Nintendo hosted a Nintendo Switch event in India on September 5-6 at R City Mall in Mumbai. The event let players watch and try demos of: • Nintendo Switch Sports • Mario Kart 8 Deluxe • Super Mario Bros.
author: ANN

title: Spin-off Manga 'Puchimas!: Petit iDOLM@STER' Concludes 18-Year Serialization
content: The official X (formerly Twitter) account of the Dengeki Maoh magazine announced on Monday that the Puchimas!: Petit iDOLM@STER spin-off manga will end with its 200th and final chapter in the issue releasing on December 25.
author: MyAnimeList

title: We Are Aliens Film's New Trailer Highlights Heroine Konatsu
content: NOTHING NEW unveiled a new trailer and visual for its We Are Aliens ( Ware Ware wa Uchūjin ) anime film with director Kōhei Kadowaki on Tuesday. Both the trailer and visual highlight the heroine Konatsu.
author: ANN

title: Silent Hill f Game Gets Manga Based on Fox Mask Character
content: Famitsu.com announced on September 9 that Silent Hill f , the recent spinoff game in the franchise, will get a new manga adaptation focused on the Fox Mask character in the Weekly Famitsu magazine in late 2026. The story is supervised by the game's original writer Ryukishi07 ( Higurashi: When They Cry ) and Konami .
author: ANN

title: Arata Aki Launches New Enma Note Demon Idol Manga
content: The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for Kadokawa 's Comic Gene magazine announced on Monday that Arata Aki will launch a new manga titled Enma Note: Jigoku Idol Project (Enma Note: Hell Idol Project) in the October issue on Tuesday.
author: ANN

title: 2027 Doraemon Film's Teaser Unveils March 5 Opening in Japan
content: Entertainment news website Cinema Today briefly posted on Monday (and reposted on Tuesday) that Eiga Doraemon: Nobita no Jōki Jikansha ( Doraemon the Movie: Nobita's Steam Time Locomotive), the 2027 Doraemon film , will open in Japan on March 5, 2027. It also posted the film's teaser video and teaser visual.
author: ANN

title: 3 Things You Need to Know for Black Clover Season 2
content: In just a few days, Black Clover Season 2 will make its highly anticipated premiere after making fans wait for five years. It’s one of the most successful action fantasies of all time, praised for its exceptional storytelling and unique world-building.
author: ComicBook

title: Atsushi Kaneko Launches New MISH/MASH Manga
content: The combined 42nd and 43rd issue of Shogakukan 's Big Comic Spirits magazine announced on Monday that Atsushi Kaneko will launch a new series titled MISH/MASH in the next issue on September 28.
author: ANN

title: Suikoden Star Leap Manga Ends
content: The October issue of Kadokawa 's Comic Flapper Magazine published the final chapter of Aki Shimizu 's manga adaptation of the Suikoden: Star Leap ( Gensō Suikoden: Star Leap ) game on September 4.
author: ANN
